title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
We specialize in delivering high-quality human-curated data and AI-first scaled operations services

Based in San Francisco and Hyderabad, we are a fast-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and societal impact

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join and build intelligent, data-driven solutions for our client that enable impactful decisions

This role requires contributions across the data science lifecycle from data wrangling and exploratory analysis to building and deploying machine learning models

Whether youre just getting started or have years of experience, were looking for individuals who are curious, analytical, and driven to make a difference with data

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and analytical solutions

Conduct exploratory data analysis and feature engineering

Own or contribute to the end-to-end data science pipeline: data cleaning, modeling, validation, and deployment

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, business) to define problems and deliver measurable impact

Translate business challenges into data science problems and communicate findings clearly

Implement A/B tests, statistical tests, and experimentation strategies

Support model monitoring, versioning, and continuous improvement in production environments

Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and best practices to improve model accuracy and scalability

Required Skills:

Strong programming skills in Python including libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn

Proficient in SQL, comfortable querying large, complex datasets

Sound understanding of statistics, machine learning algorithms, and data modeling

Experience building end-to-end ML pipelines

Exposure to or hands-on experience with model deployment tools like FastAPI, Flask, MLflow

Experience with data visualization and insight communication

Familiarity with version control tools (eg, Git) and collaborative workflows

Ability to write clean, modular code and document processes clearly

Nice to Have:

Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch

Familiarity with data engineering tools like Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt

Exposure to MLOps practices and managing models in production environments

Working knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure (e, SageMaker, BigQuery, Vertex AI)

Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests or causal inference models

Prior experience in high-growth startups or cross-functional leadership roles

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field

Location : - Mumbai, Delhi / NCR, Bengaluru , Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune,India

Job Description
The Senior Data Scientist position requires an experienced professional who is passionate about data analysis, data modeling using machine learning and product development to help us build and maintain statistical ML/AI based solutions in the AML Sanctions Compliance space, specifically supporting the Sanctions Screening. Additionally, experience in techniques including fuzzy matching, NLP based n-grams methodology, phonetics, tokenization, and similarity scoring will be desirable.
The candidate is expected to demonstrate expertise in sanctions screening and name-matching, along with experience working with rules-based or statistical models and familiarity with major sanctions platforms such as Fircosoft, ComplyAdvantage, World-Check, and Actimize, etc. will be preferable.
The candidate will be expected to have understanding of global sanctions regimes, including OFAC, EU, UN, and UK guidelines. They should demonstrate strong knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter Financing of Terrorism (CFT) frameworks, as well as financial crime compliance practices.
The candidate should be a motivated self-starter and quick learner willing to work in a high-pressure fast paced environment and globally located teams
The candidate will be extensively involved in hands-on querying, analyzing, proposing and implementing optimization solutions, conduct user acceptance testing, and support business stakeholders enquiries on ad hoc basis. Successful candidate will be working in the Compliance Technology Operations (CTO) team which is part of the Global Ethics and Compliance organization
Essential Functions:
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to conduct large scale data analysis through all stages: understand business goal and strategy, formulate analytic approaches, perform data extraction and exploration, and translate results into actionable items
  • Expertise in AI techniques (Machine learning, natural language processing, deep learning), including exposure to Generative AI technologies and their applications. Experience with Python libraries such as pandas, numpy, matplot and Scikit
  • Analyze structured and semi structured data (names, addresses, identifiers). Assess data quality, completeness, and appropriateness for sanctions screening. Define and test features used in matching and scoring logic. Partner with data engineering teams on data sourcing and transformations.
  • Build and enhance sanctions screening models using rules based and fuzzy matching techniques. Tune thresholds and scoring logic to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives. Analyze screening data and support feature design to strengthen match quality.
  • Document model logic, assumptions, and changes in an audit ready manner. Monitor model performance and implement enhancements in line with regulatory and MRM standards. Design and conduct experiments to evaluate the model performance using appropriate metrics and statistical analysis to measure and interpret results
  • Partner with Compliance, Model Risk Management, and Technology teams to support testing, validation, audits, and regulatory reviews. Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and compliance of models by overseeing and conducting thorough validations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across business units and regulated entities to enhance alignment in implementing MRM policy/standards and promote MRM best practices
  • Prepare technical documentation, including model architecture, implementation details and model methodology. Review model reports and communicate findings, insights, and recommendations to both technology and business stakeholders
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Bachelor''s/Masters Degree in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or related technical discipline
At least 5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, statistical analysis, research, data mining, trend analysis etc.

title: Business Advisory New Associate
jobDescription:
Skill required: Trust & Safety - Reporting Analytics


Designation: Business Advisory New Associate


Qualifications:Any Graduation


Years of Experience:0 to 1 years

Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries.


What would you do Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. Accentures Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society. You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns. This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accentures well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.


What are we looking for
  • Strong coping, emotional resilience, and stress-management skills
  • Excellent comprehension, communication, and (insert language) skills
  • Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of client policies
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skillsPreferred Qualifications
  • Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
  • High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported


    Roles and Responsibilities:
  • In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines
  • Your primary interaction is within your own team and your direct supervisor
  • In this role you will be given detailed instructions on all tasks
  • The decisions that you make impact your own work and are closely supervised
  • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team with a predetermined, narrow scope of work
  • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts
  • Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels
  • Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and/or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.
  • Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team
  • Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.
  • Analyze the model s responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance.
  • Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy


    Qualification Any Graduation

title: Custom Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : Web Application Development

Good to have skills : Content Management, API Management
Minimum
3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Role Overview
The Back-End Web Developer will support the Marketing organization by developing and maintaining the back-end website architecture, CMS functionality, integrations, APIs, data structures, and technical foundations that power the global marketing website and related digital properties. This role will be part of the U.S.-led Web Operations team and will partner closely with the Director of Digital Experience & Web Strategy, front-end development, web operations resources, IT, SEO, analytics, UX/design partners, and business stakeholders.
The ideal candidate should bring strong back-end development fundamentals, CMS architecture experience, integration capability, and comfort working across modern, scalable, AI-enabled digital experience environments. This is not intended to be a basic website maintenance role it is focused on building reliable, secure, scalable, and future-ready web platform capabilities.
This role will help ensure the website platform can support structured content, component reuse, personalization, intelligent search, forms, integrations, analytics, SEO/AEO/GEO requirements, global/multilingual content needs, governance, and future AI-forward digital experiences. Develop, enhance, and maintain back-end website functionality, CMS content models, schemas, integrations, APIs, and platform capabilities across the global marketing website and related digital properties.
Support back-end development for the Sanity CMS headless architecture, including schema design, GROQ queries, Sanity Studio customization, and API layer development within the Next.js framework.
Build and maintain scalable content models, taxonomies, structured content schemas, workflows, permissions, reusable content blocks, and publishing processes in Sanity that support global marketing needs.
Partner with the front-end developer to ensure back-end content structures, APIs, GROQ queries, forms, and integrations properly support front-end components and user experiences built with React, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and Storybook.
Experience working in agile/scrum workflows with 23 week sprint cycles, including the ability to lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives within a small, self-managing development team.
Support website integrations with marketing technology, analytics, forms, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Pardot), chatbot/conversational tools (Qualified), personalization platforms (Optimizely), intent data platforms (6sense), DAM (Bynder), localization (Smartling), consent tools, and other connected systems.
Ensure back-end implementation supports SEO, AEO/GEO, structured content, schema markup, metadata, redirects, performance, analytics tagging (GA4/GTM), and conversion tracking requirements.
Support data, content, and platform readiness for AI-forward digital experiences, including structured content, intelligent search, personalization, guided journeys, chatbot integrations, AI content tools (Jasper), and future automation use cases.
Maintain security, performance, reliability, scalability, accessibility support, and code quality across back-end website development work.
Participate in QA, UAT, troubleshooting, regression testing, release validation, issue resolution, and production support for website enhancements and launches.
Document back-end configuration, Sanity content models, integration logic, dependencies, release processes, and technical standards that enable the Web Operations team to scale.
Work within Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and agile delivery processes to ensure high-quality and controlled releases.
Use AI-enabled coding tools and modern development practices to improve speed, quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong development judgment.
Required Skills and Experience
5+ years of professional web development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with back-end web development, headless CMS implementation, and modern web platform architecture.
2+ years of experience with Sanity CMS, including content modeling, schema design, GROQ queries, and Sanity Studio customization or equivalent experience with another headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, Hygraph) with demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on Sanity.
3+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js in a production environment.
Experience with React and Next.js (server components, API routes, SSR/SSG) sufficient to build and maintain server-side logic and data-fetching layers.
Strong understanding of CMS content modeling, structured content, taxonomies, workflows, permissions, reusable components, and publishing structures in a headless/decoupled architecture.
Experience managing hosting and infrastructure for production web applications (Vercel, Netlify, or similar cloud platforms).
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and GraphQL and integrating third-party services, CRM/marketing technology connections, analytics tools, and web platform dependencies.
Understanding of SEO, structured content, schema markup, metadata, redirects, site performance, accessibility support, analytics tagging, and conversion tracking considerations.
Experience with content migration, environment management, deployment processes, and platform troubleshooting.
Experience supporting secure, scalable, reliable, and performant web platforms in enterprise or large-scale environments.
Experience working with Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and agile development workflows.
Familiarity with AI-enabled development tools, copilots, automated testing, debugging, or workflow automation is preferred.
Experience with B2B, SaaS, global, multilingual, or enterprise marketing websites is required.

Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with modern UI development using Tailwind CSS and reusable component libraries.
Familiarity with component documentation and design systems (e.g., Storybook, shadcn/ui).
Exposure to web analytics, A/B testing, and personalization platforms.
Experience integrating CMS, CRM, marketing automation, or DAM platforms.
Understanding of internationalization (i18n) and localization workflows.
Exposure to AI-driven content solutions and headless CMS migration initiatives.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Strong back-end web developer with expertise in headless CMS platforms, Sanity CMS, Next.js, APIs, and scalable web architectures. Systems-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable working in a global environment with cross-functional stakeholders. Demonstrates strong engineering judgment and effectively leverages AI tools to improve development quality and efficiency.
Success Measures
Back-end website functionality, Sanity CMS content models, integrations, and platform capabilities are stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs.
Sanity CMS back-end work, including schemas, GROQ queries, Studio customization, and API integrations is delivered effectively and supports self-service content publishing for the marketing team.
Website platform structures support reusable content blocks, structured content, global publishing needs, SEO/AEO/GEO requirements, analytics, and conversion tracking.
Integrations, forms, APIs, workflows, and platform dependencies are documented, maintained, and reliable.
Website enhancements and launches are delivered with strong QA, documentation, troubleshooting, and controlled release practices.
AI-enabled development practices improve productivity and quality in meaningful ways while maintaining technical control.


Qualification 15 years full time education

The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns. This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accentures well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.

  • Excellent comprehension, communication, and (insert language) skills

  • Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams

  • Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels
  • Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and/or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.

  • Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.

  • Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy.
